measurement: Angle of hip-knee line vs vertical
what_source_says (paraphrased): Standing state when knee-vertical angle is within 32 deg
notes: Defines the 'up' checkpoint. Useful as a threshold baseline vs your up/down classifier

measurement: Angle of hip-knee line vs vertical
what_source_says (paraphrased): Bottom state between 75 and 95 deg; 'lower your hips' cue at 50 to 80 deg; deep-squat warning beyond 95 deg

measurement: Angle of shoulder-hip line vs vertical
what_source_says (paraphrased): 'Bend forward' cue below 20 deg; 'bend backwards' cue above 45 deg

measurement: Angle of knee-ankle line vs vertical
what_source_says (paraphrased): 'Knee falling over toes' cue above 30 deg (treated as severe)

measurement: Change in knee frontal plane projection angle (hip-knee-ankle seen from front) vs the user's own standing value
what_source_says (paraphrased): 2D FPPA is a reliable valgus measure; smallest detectable difference 7.5 to 8.9 deg
notes: Needs front view, so it cannot run with S2 to S4 from one camera. 9 deg = change larger than measurement error, not a clinical cutoff

what_source_says (paraphrased): Return to the up position with arms fully extended
notes: 'Fully extended' has no number in the source; 160 deg allows for 2D pose noise

what_source_says (paraphrased): Lower until elbows are bent at 90 deg and upper arms are at least parallel to the floor
Back must stay straight at all times
notes: Angle alone cannot tell sag from pike: check whether the hip is below (sag) or above (pike) the shoulder-ankle line

issue_if_below_min: arms not fully extended at bottom
what_source_says (paraphrased): Start from a dead hang and lower until arms are fully extended

measurement: (Mouth y minus wrist y) / torso length; image y increases downward
what_source_says (paraphrased): Rep counts when the chin rises above the bar
notes: MediaPipe has no chin or bar landmark: mouth = chin proxy, wrists = bar height. Value > 0 means chin below hands

measurement: Angle of shoulder-hip line vs vertical
what_source_says (paraphrased): No kipping, kicking, or swinging to help the pull
notes: Threshold is a starting guess; tune on real reps

measurement: Angle of shoulder-hip line vs the ground (horizontal)
what_source_says (paraphrased): Raise the upper body to or beyond vertical (base of neck above base of spine)
notes: Source value is exact; 2D noise may require a few degrees of tolerance

measurement: Angle of shoulder-hip line vs the ground (horizontal)
what_source_says (paraphrased): Lower until the bottom of the shoulder blades touch the ground
Knees bent so upper and lower legs form 90 deg; knees may not exceed 90 deg
notes: Army FM 7-22 (2012) changed the start position to 45 deg; this sheet uses the FM 21-20 standard

what_source_says (paraphrased): Jump with legs more than shoulder-width apart
notes: Ratio 1.0 is a direct translation of 'more than shoulder width'

what_source_says (paraphrased): Swing the arms sideward and upward to an overhead position and clap the hands
Return to the position of attention (feet together)
Return to the position of attention (arms at sides)
